_doc: Known cloud incidents with their fingerprint, cause and the fix that lives in code (master brief 2026-10-22, stage B). doctor searches this before any diagnosis; a new incident is appended by `python -m explainer_engine.cloud incidents add` or by hand. Sources: TMR docs/INCIDENTS_RUNPOD.md (2026-10-10..15), docs/PROGRESS.md and RISK_REGISTER R-29 here. error_class values come from incidents.CLASSES.

incidents.symptom: setup: `set: pipefail: invalid option`
incidents.cause: a .sh written on Windows had CRLF line ends
incidents.fix: the bundle converts .sh to LF; a test checks no \r in cloud/*.sh

incidents.symptom: cmake: CMAKE_CUDA_COMPILER-NOTFOUND
incidents.cause: nvcc is not on PATH in an ssh/conductor shell
incidents.fix: setup exports /usr/local/cuda/bin and passes -DCMAKE_CUDA_COMPILER

incidents.symptom: torch has no attribute accelerator
incidents.cause: the image's torch 2.4 is older than diffusers needs
incidents.fix: own venv with the pinned torch; never rely on the image's python packages

incidents.symptom: STATUS_TOKEN is not set
incidents.cause: an ssh session does not get the pod's env
incidents.fix: the start script reads /proc/1/environ

incidents.symptom: the pod stayed on after DONE
incidents.cause: the in-pod stop failed (REST 400 with the injected key); the cap was only checked between stages; the money clock started at the conductor, not at the pod
incidents.fix: the guard runs outside the pod with the pod's own clock; stop via REST then GraphQL, verified by GET; the cap kills a running stage

incidents.symptom: a stopped pod would not restart: not enough free GPUs on the host
incidents.cause: a stopped pod is tied to its host
incidents.fix: one pod per run; never rely on `start`; a stopped disk is a decision for the creator, not a plan

incidents.symptom: pgrep -f / pkill -f over ssh matched (and killed) its own shell; state.json kept saying RUNNING
incidents.cause: the remote command line contains the pattern it searches for
incidents.fix: kill by PID read from a file, pgrep -x / pkill -x, never a pattern that appears in your own command

incidents.symptom: `command timed out` at 40 min; all pieces done, the join killed
incidents.cause: the stage limit was guessed, not computed from measured speeds
incidents.fix: limits computed from measured speeds (RISK_REGISTER R-29, manifest lint picture_budget / fatal_before_push)

incidents.symptom: the guard printed `conductor unknown` the whole run
incidents.cause: RunPod's proxy (Cloudflare) answers 403 to Python's default User-Agent
incidents.fix: status_page() sends a User-Agent

incidents.symptom: after STOP/START: `A virtual environment already exists` and no ffmpeg; apt lists empty
incidents.cause: the container disk is wiped on stop; only /workspace survives
incidents.fix: setup reinstalls uv/apt packages idempotently; prefer one pod per run

incidents.symptom: pod 'failed' while the session kept uploading
incidents.cause: the conductor stops the pod after 15 min without a decision; the session ignored the BLOCKED push
incidents.fix: a BLOCKED push is answered first; the job record shows RECOVERY_REQUIRED

incidents.symptom: No module named huggingface_hub on a fresh pod
incidents.cause: a package had been installed by hand into the system python on the first pod
incidents.fix: every dependency installed by the setup stage from a pinned list; nothing by hand

incidents.symptom: the llama.cpp CUDA build (15-20 min on a loaded host) did not fit the 20-min setup limit and restarted from zero on retry
incidents.cause: rm -rf build before every attempt; the limit ignored host load
incidents.fix: a baked image (ghcr.io tmr-pod) carries the build; setup limits from measurements

incidents.symptom: the pod idled ~30 min after create; the background guard was killed by a 30-min tool limit; the pod stayed RUNNING
incidents.cause: the guard ran inside a tool call with a time limit
incidents.fix: guard_detached(): the guard is its own process; the watchdog outside the session stops anything past its -until- name

incidents.symptom: an empty log and a truncated upload reached the store
incidents.cause: push filtered by file name only
incidents.fix: store.push checks every file (JSON parses, images load, MP4 boxes add up); verify compares size and sha256

incidents.symptom: llama-server never became ready
incidents.cause: ssh sessions do not get the image's ENV (LD_LIBRARY_PATH); libllama not found
incidents.fix: the conductor exports the image ENV itself

incidents.symptom: created with a start command, never reached a status page; no IP for ~16 min, runtime null
incidents.cause: inferred: the start command's process returned and the container restarted in a loop
incidents.fix: boot_cmd ends with `tail -f /dev/null`; the guard stops a pod that never answered by its boot deadline

incidents.symptom: a stage 'passed' although the pipeline died; the next stage failed on a missing file
incidents.cause: the command hid the exit code (a pipe without pipefail)
incidents.fix: set -o pipefail in every stage command; a stage passes only on exit 0 and its expected outputs

incidents.symptom: cuda check exit 127: /workspace/zenv/bin/python: No such file
incidents.cause: the check ran before the stage that creates the venv
incidents.fix: manifest lint `before` rule

incidents.symptom: the conductor's money clock used the manifest price ($0.9/h) on a $0.27/h card: 3x overstated
incidents.cause: the price was a constant, not read from the pod
incidents.fix: the guard reads costPerHr from the pod and corrects the session price; a PROVISIONING pod's 0 falls back to the ceiling (never to 0)

incidents.symptom: 35 finished pictures lost when the stage limit killed the pod stage before the push
incidents.cause: the only copy lived on the pod disk; the limit was copied from a smaller job
incidents.fix: push before any fatal stop; the job record lists outputs and refuses a release while any is unstored (RISK_REGISTER R-29)

incidents.symptom: a stopped 60 GB preflight pod billed $0.40/day for three days
incidents.cause: a stopped pod keeps its volume at $0.20/GB/month and nobody looked
incidents.fix: check/sweep list every stopped disk with its $/day; the session hooks refuse to end a turn while one is unkept
